function: Estimates the cascaded user-RIS-BS channel in uplink under receiver noise and RIS phase noise (p. 2).
system: BS with N=16 antennas (4x4 UPA), single-antenna user, passive reflecting RIS with M=32 elements (8x4), direct link blocked; frequency band not stated (p. 2; p. 5).
method: Conditional diffusion model, U-Net noise predictor trained with likelihood-based loss on ground-truth channels (supervised); pilot and RIS-phase gradient guidance; progressive distillation (p. 3; p. 4).
data_channel: Synthetic Saleh-Valenzuela channels, LG and Lh uniform in [3, 6] paths, for BS-RIS and user-RIS links; no 3GPP model, public dataset, or measurement (p. 2; p. 5).
test_conditions: Trained once for all SNR settings (p. 2); one configuration N=16, M=32 (p. 5); evaluated versus SNR, pilot density Q/M, and phase-noise variance; no other scenario reported.
baselines: Classical: DS-OMP (compressed sensing) and TSCE (iterative); learned: CDRN (CNN residual network); variant ignoring phase noise (p. 4; p. 5).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR, pilot density Q/M, and RIS phase-noise variance; sampling steps 1024 versus 32 (p. 4; p. 5).
complexity: Table I gives complexity orders of the proposed method (U-Net forward pass times T sampling steps), DS-OMP, TSCE, and CDRN; T reducible to 32 by distillation (p. 4).
openness: none; no code or data link or release statement in the letter (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 2: "we adopt the Saleh-Valenzuela model to formulate the RIS-BS" - a custom simulator; no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO, or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 2: "it only requires training once across all SNR settings" - an SNR sweep; the pilot-density and phase-noise sweeps (p. 5) use the same channel model and N=16, M=32; no unseen scenario, band, or dataset is stated.
q3_support: p. 5: "6.43 dB gain against DS-OMP, CDRN, and TSCE" - NMSE gains over the non-learned DS-OMP and TSCE and over the learned CDRN, a CNN-based residual network [13] (p. 4).
q4_support: p. 4: "The comparison of computational complexity is provided in Table I." - Table I lists the complexity order of the proposed method and of DS-OMP, TSCE, and CDRN.
q5_support: p. 5: "The number of multipath components LG , Lh are uniformly distributed in [3, 6]" - channels are generated by the authors' own simulation; no code or data link, public dataset, or measurement is given.
notes: q2 is borderline: Fig. 4(b),(c) vary pilot density and phase-noise variance with the same model (the U-Net is trained on channels only, Algorithm 1, p. 3), but the paper never states a training configuration that differs from the test one, so 0. Frequency band not stated.
